finalists.label: Psoriatic Arthritis
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as small red node and mild joint deformity at distal interphalangeal joint of left index finger and morning stiffness and knee pain, more severe in the mornings and improving throughout the day.

finalists.label: Arthritis
finalists.why: It has broad findings including developed joint symptoms, followed by acute back pain and paresthesia, morning stiffness and knee pain, more severe in the mornings and improving throughout the day, and small red node and mild joint deformity at distal interphalangeal joint of left index finger.

finalists.label: Rosuvastatin-induced Myopathy
finalists.why: It has specific findings related to rosuvastatin use and subsequent development of joint symptoms and back pain.

frontier_selector.why: Psoriatic Arthritis is chosen due to its specific findings such as small red node and mild joint deformity at distal interphalangeal joint of left index finger, which are not fully explained by the other finalists.
